mcu: STM32G474cc
#package: UFBGA64
#package: WLCSP81
package: UFQFPN48

port clock:
  channel IN = RCC_OSCIN
  channel OUT = RCC_OSCOUT
  color "brown"
  
  
port debug:
  channel DIO = *_SWDIO
  channel JDI = *_JTDI
  channel CLK = *_SWCLK
  channel SWO = *_SWO
  channel TX = USART*_TX $u
  channel RX = USART*_RX $u
#  channel DP = USB*_OTGFSDP
#  channel DM = USB*_OTGFSDM
  require dma(TX, "USART_TX")
  require dma(RX, "USART_RX")
  color "brown"
    

port SAFETY:
  channel APP_TX = USART*_TX $au
  channel APP_RX = USART*_RX $au
  channel SAFE_TX = USART*_TX $su
  channel SAFE_RX = USART*_RX $su
  require dma(APP_TX, "USART_TX")
  require dma(APP_RX, "USART_TX")
  require dma(SAFE_TX, "USART_TX")
  require dma(SAFE_RX, "USART_TX")


port ENC0: @ ~W
  channel MA
  channel MO
  channel SL
  channel CS
  color "orange"

  config "SPI": 
    SL = SPI*_MISO $s
    MA = SPI*_SCK $s
    MO = SPI*_MOSI $s # reserved for future use
    require dma(SL, "SPI_RX")
    
  # optional
  config "UART": 
    SL = USART*_RX $u # reserved for future use, connected
    require dma(SL, "USART_RX")


port ENC1 from ENC0: @ ~N
  color "green"
  
port ENC2 from ENC0: @ ~W
  color "red"
  
  #config "TIM":
  #  MO = TIM[1,2,3,4,5,8,20]_CH[1,2] $t
  #  SL = TIM*_CH[1,2] $t
  #  MA = TIM*_CH[3,4] $t


port MOT: 
  # sto
  channel STO0_IN = TIM[1,8]_BKIN$t
  channel STO1_IN = TIM*_BKIN2 $t
  channel VLGATE_EN = TIM*_CH* $t
  channel VHGATE_EN = TIM*_CH* $t
  channel STO0_OUT = OUT
  channel STO1_OUT1 = OUT
  channel d0 = OUT
  channel d1 = OUT
  channel d2 = OUT
  channel d3 = OUT
  channel d4 = OUT
  channel d5 = OUT


  channel BRAKE_OUT = TIM*_CH* $t

  # phase, dc, brake currents
  # channel IA = ADC1_IN[0-3]
  # channel IB = ADC2_IN[0-3]
  # channel IC = ADC3_IN[0-3]
  channel IDC = ADC1_IN*
  channel IBRAKE = ADC2_IN*

  # phase, dc voltages
  channel UA = ADC1_IN[1-6]
  channel UB = ADC2_IN[1-6]
  channel UC = ADC3_IN[1-6]
  channel UDC = ADC3_IN*
  channel UBRAKE = ADC1_IN*
  channel ULGATE = ADC2_IN*
  channel UHGATE = ADC3_IN*


  require dma(UA)
  require dma(UB)
  require dma(UC)
  color "blue"
